description: Part of a beige multi-story residential building facade, a recessed pedestrian entrance area with a white pillar, a beige wall with a call box, two adjacent white doors, a sign above the doors with Chinese characters "朝逸大廈" and "2030 VALLEJO", a circular light fixture to the left of the sign, a planter box with dense green vegetation, an asphalt driveway slanting downwards into a recessed garage entrance under the building, a utility pole, and multiple upper floors with balconies featuring light-colored vertical bar railings.

Urban residential street, overcast sky with scattered clouds, asphalt street sloping uphill, multiple wooden utility poles with dense overhead wires, row of multi-story residential buildings on the left partially obscured by trees, concrete sidewalk, multi-story light gray building with a garage, multi-story light blue-gray building with an arched entrance, garage, and white trim, multi-story light yellow-beige building with a garage, white trim, and a large spherical-shaped trimmed bush, multi-story dark gray building with an external staircase, red door, white trim, and another large spherical-shaped trimmed bush, partially visible adjacent multi-story gray building, white street signpost on the right sidewalk.
Dense evergreen trees with visible trunks covering a steep, green and brown grassy hillside, with patches of bare earth and scrubby vegetation, leading to a paved road with a curb on the right.
